facts.text: Maria shared a photo of three children sitting on a step smiling, which she described as kids she met at the shelter.

evidence.quote: Check out these kids I met at the shelter! [image: a photo of three children sitting on a step smiling]

facts.text: Maria mentioned that a car ran a red light and hit them, causing damage to their vehicle, but everyone was unharmed.

evidence.quote: Something not so great happened yesterday...
A car ran a red light and hit us, but thankfully everyone is okay.

facts.text: Maria also mentioned that her cousin had a tough time recently and she is helping her find a new place.

evidence.quote: Besides that, my cousin just had a tough time recently, so I'm lending a hand in helping her find a new place.
